description:
FILED s532 (Fable 5.1, 2026-11-02) at the s532a merge probe (scratch p532a/b.pl): my @st = (1,2); my $n = eval { &CORE::push(\@st, 3) }; print defined $n ? $n : "ERR $@"; -- perl 5.40.3: 3 (and &CORE::unshift(\@st, 0) -> 4); d47caabe and main 70ff3112 alike: push -> "Experimental push on scalar is now forbidden at (eval 0) line 0." (perl-shaped at least), unshift -> a RAW Lisp error printing the p-box struct (rule 12 / the tidy-error rule).  perldoc CORE: a builtin called as &CORE::NAME follows its prototype -- push/unshift/splice/keys/values/each/pop/shift/delete/exists take their aggregate as a REFERENCE (`\@`, `\%`, `\[@%]`), and the arity is enforced (#1577).  NOT a regression of #4362 (s532a restored d47caabe's emission; this shape was wrong before #3859 too).  Rows: t/op/coreamp.t "&push with scalarref arg" / "&pop with hashref arg" / the &CORE:: aggregate rows past row 67 (the file stops there on `&CORE::exit((1)x2)`, #1577).  FIX SHAPE: the `&CORE::NAME` lowering (Pl/ExprToCL.pm, `amp_ignores_prototype`'s CORE:: arm after s532a) must apply the builtin's PROTOTYPE to the argument list -- a `\@` slot dereferences its reference argument (and dies perl's "Type of arg 1 to &CORE::push must be array reference" otherwise) -- the same prototype table the user-sub `\@` slot already uses (rule 11); the raw error for unshift is the rule-12 half.  Layer: Pl/ (the lowering) + cl/ (the die text).  Owner family: #1577.

=== DONE (s536f) ===
Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08.  FIXED (the aggregate-slot half; the arity half stays #1577's).  gen_funcall_form wraps the first argument of an `&CORE::NAME(...)` call (the `amp_core` marker) whose builtin prototype's FIRST slot is an aggregate -- `\@` push / unshift / splice / pop / shift, `\[%@]` keys / values / each, read from perl's own `prototype("CORE::NAME")` (`_core_amp_aggr_kind`) -- in `(p-core-amp-aggr ARG "NAME" :array|:aggr)`, a new exported runtime function that answers the referenced container (`p-cast-@` / `p-cast-%`) or dies perl's "Type of arg 1 to &CORE::NAME must be array reference" / "hash or array reference" -- an aggregate spread into the list (`&CORE::push(@a, 1)`) included.  Probes scratch/s536f/p/m6.pl: push 3, unshift 4, pop, shift, splice, keys / values of a hash ref and keys of an array ref, each, and the four die shapes = perl; the raw Lisp error is gone.  `\&CORE::push` as a code ref is still #1577's ("p-push is a macro").  The `\[$@%*]` builtins (tie / tied / untie / lock / undef) are NOT wrapped (no probe here).  Guard Pl/t/amp-call-proto-01.t prog `core-amp-aggr` (FAILS on c8886b61).  IR inventory regenerated (`p-core-amp-aggr` in the reference family).

No baseline row is keyed on this task.
subject: `&CORE::push(\@a, LIST)` / `&CORE::unshift(\@a, LIST)` -- a builtin whose prototype starts with `\@` (or `\%`) takes a REFERENCE as that argument when called through `&CORE::NAME` (perl 5.40 prints 3 / 4); PCL dies "Experimental push on scalar is now forbidden" for push and a RAW Lisp type error for unshift -- pre-existing (d47caabe = main), #1577's coreargs family
